restoration: Removed the critical-ui dynamic bootloader architecture and restored the pre-loader pattern: index.html directly loads app.js as a module; app.js directly owns Start and Search listeners during initialize().
reference: This matches the architecture visible in the earlier working 1.8.8 GitHub revision: direct <script type=module src=app.js> and app-owned button handling.
limitation: The sandbox browser blocks navigation to a localhost HTTP server, so full-page module loading could not be exercised end-to-end here. The native event architecture itself was executed in Chromium, all release JS passes syntax checks, and the roadtrip regression is 49/49.
